name: Northern lights, then Philly
lede: Four or five nights in northern Canada around the new moon on 6 February, then a week or two in West Philly at Jabari’s place. Three places to see the aurora, none decided, and what to wear at −25 °C when neither of us owns a parka.
blurb: Five nights under the aurora in northern Canada around the February new moon, then West Philly. Yellowknife, Whitehorse or Churchill, and the clothes for it.
description: February 2027: four or five nights for the northern lights in Yellowknife, Whitehorse or Churchill, what to wear at −25 °C, then a week or two in Philly.
